thread:
Maya: Quick sync — we need final owners for SDK v1.4 docs + quickstarts before changelog cutoff tomorrow 10:00 PT. Who's taking quickstart e2e and sample app stability fixes?
Liam: I can own Node + Go quickstarts. Will run the end-to-end and update samples.
Sanjay: I'll take the Python quickstart and the integration guide. Priya — can you triage the flaky auth in sample-apps?
Priya: On it. Fixing the auth race now, PR incoming in ~30m: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/324 (adds retry + better env checks).
Maya: Thanks — assign reviewers: @Liam @Sanjay. Also we need a one-line changelog bullet. Please add to docs/changelog.md under "Unreleased".
Liam: pinging @Carla for CR on sdk-js (#789). It's a small docs + typings tweak.
Carla: I can review after standup (around 10:30 PT). @Liam leave a short note if any API surface changed.
docs-bot: Branch created: release/v1.4-candidate by @Maya — CI queued (checks: unit, e2e, lint).
QA: I can run a quick smoke on sample-apps once the PR lands; ETA ~1h after merge. Need test creds for the integration env.
Priya: Added temporary test creds to vault at secrets/devex/quickstart-test (will rotate post-smoke). I also added a short debug log to help track the auth race.
Maya: Owners recap: Node/Go = Liam, Python/docs = Sanjay, Sample fixes = Priya, CR reviewers = Carla + Liam. Changelog cutoff 10:00 PT tomorrow. If you hit a blocker reply here by 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
Liam: Noted. I'll also toggle the samplepack canary flag to reduce 503 noise during tests: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/flags/toggle -d 'flag=samplepack_canary&on=true'`
Sanjay: Adding changelog line now: "SDK: improvements to quickstart reliability and minor docs updates."
Maya: Thanks — I'll merge changelog after approvals and green CI. If everything is green we'll cut the candidate at 11:00 PT. If anyone can't meet these times please flag here so we can reassign.
Carla: Review submitted for #789. Left one comment about a type definition — small.
Priya: PR merged. QA please kick off smoke when you see the merge.
QA: Kicking off smoke now. Will report back within 40m.
Maya: Awesome, will follow up in an hour. If QA finds issues we may delay cutoff by up to 1h but we'll communicate ASAP.
file_notes: release coordination, changelog cutoff, quickstarts, sample-app fixes, code review pings
